chunks: It is a (source of) remembrance/greatness for you and your people, and you will surely be questioned about it.

key_terms.تُسْأَلُونَ: You will be questioned (about the message)
key_terms.ذِكْرٌ: Remembrance, reminder, or source of dignity/greatness
key_terms.لِقَوْمِكَ: For your people (the community of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being a 'dhikr' for the Prophet and his people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual role of the Quran as both a source of honor for the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, and a binding testimony against the community on the Day of Judgment. It underscores the necessity of not only receiving the revelation but also implementing its teachings, particularly the guidance of the Imams, to avoid accountability for neglect.
